extra.final_summary: Average unit price by category (69 rows used, after fixes): Accessories $32.00, Electronics $277.33, Furniture $191.05, Office Supplies $11.10. Problems found and fixed: (1) two misspelled Category labels — "Furnture" (row 20) and "Office Suplies" (row 9) — merged into the allowed labels "Furniture" and "Office Supplies" via normalize_labels, since the rules file restricts Category to four allowed values; (2) one exact duplicate row (row 5, a repeat of Order_ID 2005) removed via drop_duplicates so it wouldn't double-count in the average. Price itself was clean (all numeric, no negatives, min $6, max $900). Caveats: rows with negative Quantity (3 rows) were left alone because Quantity is not used in this question and the rules don't say to exclude them; Region has whitespace variants and 2 missing values, but Region is also not used here.
